I had a big argument with Lily about family stuff."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm sorry to hear that. It must be hard having a fight with someone close to you. What happened, if you feel like sharing?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"We've always had different views on family responsibilities, but this time it got really heated. She thinks I'm not doing enough."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds really stressful. It must be tough feeling like your efforts aren't recognized."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yeah, exactly. I'm trying to help as much as I can, especially with work being so demanding."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Balancing work and family can be really challenging. You're doing your best, and it sounds like you're being stretched thin."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I just feel overwhelmed sometimes. I want to be there for my family but also need to take care of myself."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's completely understandable to feel that way. It's important to find a balance that works for you, too."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Then there’s the guilt. I keep thinking about how maybe I should be doing more."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Guilt can be so tough to deal with. But remember, you're only human. You're allowed to set boundaries and take care of yourself."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I know, but it's hard to shake off. I want things to be okay between Lily and me."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I understand. It shows how much you care about your relationship with her. Have you thought about how you might approach things with Lily moving forward?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I've been thinking of reaching out and talking it over calmly. I don't want this to become a bigger issue."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds like a really thoughtful approach. Clear communication might help both of you understand each other better."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I hope so. I just hate being in this kind of conflict. It feels exhausting."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Conflicts can be really draining, but resolving them can also lead to stronger bonds. You're strong for facing it head-on."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thanks for saying that. I guess I'll try to focus on the good side of it."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Absolutely. Lean on David too; he's there to support you. How are things going with him?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"He's been great, actually. Moving in together has been a big help for me emotionally, especially after losing my dog."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's wonderful to hear you have that support. David seems like a solid rock for you during tough times."}]
